thread:
Ava: quick one — we need a pared-down set of competitive claims for next week's launch post + webinar. focus: vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. can we agree on 3 crisp claims and 2 rebut bullets each?

Jamal: sounds good. my vote: 1) predictable cost per request (econ), 2) consistent latency & fallbacks (reliability), 3) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private (flexibility). keep each claim one line.

Priya: +1 to those pillars. for messaging AB tests: short headline (10–12 words) + single-line subheads that show outcome. e.g., "Serve reliably, pay less per token." vs "Same API, lower tail latency and cost predictability."

Luca: benchmark narrative note — don't lead with raw P50 numbers. frame as "real workload delta" and show a small, honest methodology blurb. we should include a single chart: latency by tail decile + cost per 1M tokens. add a short caveat: dataset & prompt shapes used.

Megan: please remove any absolute words like "always" or "cheaper". legal flagged "guaranteed cheaper" as risky. also need an owner for the slide that explains fallbacks (model variants, region routing). can someone take?

Ava: @Megan assigned. @Jamal you can run quick claim tests with SEs. I'll draft the two headline variants and a 90s webinar opener.

Jamal: ok I'll run a 48h internal poll with solutions / AE teams. putting 3 quick rebut templates here for ops: 
- If they say "we have our own infra": "Great — we surface the same controls but remove ops burden for app teams and give predictable economics at scale." 
- If they say "API simplicity is enough": "We match simple APIs but add production observability + native deployment modes for regulated workloads." 
- If they say "our cloud has global regions": "We route by region and offer enterprise-dedicated placements to meet locality & compliance needs."

Priya: draft one-liners for social/webinar promos: 
- "Ship reliable LLM features — without overprovisioning GPUs." 
- "Same API, predictable price & latency for production." 
- "From POC to SLA: serving you can trust."

Luca: sample benchmark blurb for slides (short): 
```
Method: 10k real-user prompts (median len 120 tokens) across 3 models. Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and normalized token cost. We compare common hosted endpoints and a dedicated instance tuned for throughput.
```

Megan: clean. can we also add a one-slide "failure modes & graceful degradation" flow?Ops wants to show fallback to smaller quantized model, then region fallback, then queueing policy. that helps sales answer "what if capacity spikes".

Ava: yes — put that as slide 7 in the deck. small action list: 
• Ava — write the two headline variants and webinar opener (today)
• Jamal — run 48h SE poll + collect 3 live rebut examples (48h)
• Priya — craft promo copy variants for landing + social (end of day)
• Luca — produce the small benchmark blurb + chart draft (tomorrow)
• Megan — own failure-modes slide + legal-safe phrasing (tomorrow)

ops-bot: deploy note: new deck revision created at https://notion.redwood/competitive/claim-rapid-stitch (version 1) :white_check_mark:

Jamal: great, I'll ping when poll results are in. if anyone has short customer quotes that support "predictable econ" drop them here. :thumbsup:

Priya: uploading a 1-sentence quote from a beta customer now: "We moved to Redwood Dedicated and our per-request costs stabilized — we can forecast spend for the quarter."

Ava: perfect. thanks all — keeping this tight is the plan. we'll ship the promo copy after Jamal's poll and Luca's chart. :rocket:
